PRIVACY POLICY FOR WIZSCHEDULER

Effective Date: April 5, 2026
Last Updated: October 12, 2026

1. INTRODUCTION
WizScheduler ("we", "our", "us") is a multi-tenant AI-powered employee scheduling platform operated by Suggestival LLC. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your personal data when you use our service. We are committed to protecting your privacy in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), the New York SHIELD Act, and other applicable data protection laws.

2. DATA WE COLLECT
We collect the following categories of personal data:

A. ACCOUNT INFORMATION
- Full name, email address, hashed password
- Company name and location information
- Phone number (optional)
- Account preferences and language settings

B. EMPLOYEE PROFILE DATA
- Full name, email address (if provided), phone number (optional)
- Assigned roles and job titles
- Skill levels and competency ratings
- Work location assignments
- Hire date and employment status
- Seniority ratings

C. AVAILABILITY AND SCHEDULING DATA
- Weekly availability windows (day, start time, end time)
- Shift preferences and constraints
- Vacation and time-off requests
- Shift history and assigned shifts
- Schedule compliance flags (Fair Workweek violations, etc.)

D. WORK PREFERENCE DATA
- Interpersonal affinity scores between employees (used to optimize team composition and reduce conflicts)
- Affinity expiration dates
- Team preference annotations
- Pay rate information (for scheduling signals)
- Overtime and seniority signals

E. TECHNICAL DATA
- IP addresses (recorded during login and API requests)
- JWT authentication tokens (not stored server-side beyond session)
- Browser type and version
- Device identifiers
- Timestamps of access

F. USAGE DATA
- API request logs for error monitoring
- Feature usage patterns
- Schedule generation history
- Check-in activity (location, time, date)

3. HOW WE USE YOUR DATA
We process your personal data for the following purposes:

A. SCHEDULE GENERATION (PRIMARY USE CASE)
Your availability, roles, skill levels, seniority, pay rates, affinities, and preferences are sent to Anthropic's Claude AI to generate optimized weekly shift schedules. Data is transmitted via encrypted API calls and is not retained by Anthropic beyond the API request lifecycle. Schedule generation is never used for training AI models.

B. ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT
To create and maintain your user account, authenticate sessions via JWT, manage multi-tenant company access, and enforce role-based access controls.

C. COMMUNICATION
To send transactional emails (welcome, password resets, schedule notifications, schedule generation results) via our email service provider, Resend. We do not send marketing emails without your explicit opt-in.

D. DATA IMPORT/EXPORT
To facilitate integration with 7shifts, Deputy, Homebase, and other scheduling systems for importing and exporting employee and schedule data at your request.

E. COMPLIANCE CHECKING
To validate schedules against Fair Workweek and other labor law requirements, and to generate compliance reports.

F. SERVICE IMPROVEMENT
To monitor errors, analyze usage patterns, improve scheduling algorithms, and develop new features based on aggregate, anonymized data.

G. SECURITY AND FRAUD PREVENTION
To detect and prevent unauthorized access, monitor for abuse, and maintain service security.

4. LEGAL BASIS FOR PROCESSING (GDPR)
We process your data based on:
- Consent: You provide explicit consent during registration for data processing and AI-powered scheduling.
- Contractual Necessity: Processing is necessary to provide the scheduling service you have requested.
- Legitimate Interest: For security, fraud prevention, service improvement, and compliance with law.
- Legal Obligation: To comply with labor law reporting requirements and court orders.

5. DATA SHARING AND THIRD-PARTY PROCESSORS
We share your data with the following third-party processors only when necessary:

A. ANTHROPIC (CLAUDE AI)
- Purpose: AI-powered schedule generation
- Data Shared: Employee names, roles, skill levels, availability, affinities, preferences
- Safeguards: Data transmitted via encrypted API calls; not retained beyond request lifecycle; explicitly not used for model training
- Legal Basis: Your consent and contractual necessity

B. THIRD-PARTY SCHEDULING PLATFORMS
- Purpose: Employee and schedule data import/export
- Data Shared: Employee profiles, shift schedules, and related workforce data
- Examples: 7shifts, Deputy, Homebase
- Safeguards: Data transferred only at customer's explicit request; encrypted in transit; user controls which fields are exported
- Legal Basis: Your explicit instruction

C. RESEND (EMAIL SERVICE PROVIDER)
- Purpose: Transactional email delivery
- Data Shared: Email addresses, recipient names, email content
- Safeguards: Data processed solely for email delivery; encrypted in transit; Resend does not use data for marketing
- Legal Basis: Contractual necessity

D. CLOUD INFRASTRUCTURE PROVIDER
- Purpose: Data storage and hosting
- Data Shared: All application data including user accounts, employee profiles, availability, schedules
- Safeguards: Encryption at rest and in transit; access restricted to application service; regular backups
- Legal Basis: Contractual necessity

We do not sell your personal data to advertisers or third parties.

6. DATA RETENTION
We retain your personal data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide services:
- Active Account: All data retained during the service period
- After Account Deletion: All personal data is permanently deleted within 30 days, including employee profiles, availability, affinities, shift history, check-ins, and consent records
- Compliance Records: We may retain limited audit logs for up to 1 year to comply with legal obligations
- Backups: Data in database backups is encrypted and retained per our backup policy (typically 30 days)

7. YOUR RIGHTS
Under GDPR, CCPA, and applicable laws, you have the right to:

A. ACCESS: Request a copy of all personal data we hold about you (GET /api/v1/gdpr/export)
B. RECTIFICATION: Update or correct your personal data through the account dashboard
C. ERASURE: Request deletion of your account and all associated data (DELETE /api/v1/gdpr/delete-account)
D. DATA PORTABILITY: Receive your data in a structured, machine-readable JSON format
E. WITHDRAW CONSENT: You may withdraw consent at any time, though this may limit your ability to use the service
F. RESTRICTION OF PROCESSING: Request that we limit how we use your data
G. OBJECT: Object to processing based on legitimate interests
H. OPT-OUT OF ANALYTICS: You can opt out of aggregate analytics tracking

To exercise these rights, submit a request to admin@suggestival.com with proof of identity.

8. DATA SECURITY
We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data:
- Passwords are hashed using bcrypt and never stored in plaintext
- Authentication via signed JWT tokens with configurable expiration
- Multi-tenant data isolation ensures company data is strictly separated at the application and database level
- All API communications are encrypted via TLS 1.2 or higher
- Security headers (HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options) are enforced
- Regular security updates and vulnerability monitoring
- Data encrypted at rest in database backups
- Limited access control: only authorized service components access user data

While we implement robust security measures, no system is 100% secure. We maintain cyber insurance and breach notification procedures.

9. INTERNATIONAL DATA TRANSFERS
Your data may be transferred to and processed in the United States or other countries where we or our sub-processors operate. We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place:
- EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) with each sub-processor
- Transfer Impact Assessments where required under GDPR
- Data adequacy assessments for target jurisdictions

10. CHILDREN'S PRIVACY
Our service is not directed to individuals under 16. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If we become aware that a child under 16 has provided data, we will delete it promptly.

11. CALIFORNIA CONSUMER PRIVACY ACT (CCPA)
California residents have the right to know, delete, and opt-out of the sale of personal information. We do not sell personal information as defined by CCPA. For CCPA-specific requests, contact admin@suggestival.com.

12. NEW YORK PRIVACY RIGHTS
New York residents have the right to know, delete, and opt-out of targeted advertising. We do not engage in targeted advertising. For NY Privacy Rights Act requests, contact admin@suggestival.com.

13. COOKIES AND TRACKING
We use minimal cookies:
- Authentication cookies: Required for session management
- Preference cookies: Optional, stored locally on your device
- Analytics: Aggregate, anonymized analytics only; no individual user tracking

You can disable non-essential cookies in your browser settings.

14. THIRD-PARTY LINKS
Our website may contain links to third-party services (7shifts, Deputy, etc.). This Privacy Policy applies only to WizScheduler. We are not responsible for third-party privacy practices.

15. CHANGES TO THIS POLICY
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of material changes via email or in-app notification at least 30 days in advance. Continued use of the service after changes constitutes acceptance.

16. CONTACT AND DATA PROTECTION OFFICER
For privacy inquiries, data subject requests, or complaints:
- Email: admin@suggestival.com
- Address: Available upon request
- Response Time: We respond to data subject requests within 30 days (45 days for complex requests)

If you are dissatisfied with our response, you may lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

TERMS OF SERVICE FOR WIZSCHEDULER

Effective Date: April 5, 2026
Last Updated: October 12, 2026

1. ACCEPTANCE OF TERMS
By accessing or using WizScheduler ("the Service"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service ("Terms"). If you do not agree, you may not use the Service. These Terms apply to all users, including managers, employees, and administrators.

2. DESCRIPTION OF SERVICE
WizScheduler is a SaaS employee scheduling platform developed by Suggestival LLC that uses AI (Anthropic's Claude) to generate optimized weekly shift schedules. The Service includes employee management, availability tracking, role assignment, skill-based rotation, team affinity optimization, shift generation, compliance checking (including NYC Fair Workweek), schedule export features, and employee self-service interfaces.

3. ACCOUNTS AND REGISTRATION
You must register for an account to use the Service. You agree to:
- Provide accurate, current information during registration
- Maintain the security of your login credentials
- Accept responsibility for all activity under your account
- Notify us immediately of any unauthorized access
- Accept our Privacy Policy and these Terms (required during registration)

You may only register one account per person. Registering multiple accounts to circumvent limitations is prohibited.

4. USER ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

A. MANAGERS/ADMINISTRATORS
- Responsible for ensuring employee consent for data processing
- Responsible for accurate employee data entry
- Responsible for reviewing AI-generated schedules before publishing
- Responsible for compliance with all applicable labor laws
- Responsible for maintaining account security and managing team access

B. EMPLOYEES
- Responsible for providing accurate availability information
- Responsible for updating profile data
- Responsible for checking schedules promptly after publication
- Employees do not have responsibility for compliance—managers do

5. MULTI-TENANT ARCHITECTURE
The Service operates as a multi-tenant platform with strict data isolation:
- Each company's data is logically and technically isolated
- You may only access data belonging to your authorized company
- Cross-tenant data access is prohibited and monitored
- We enforce role-based access control (RBAC) at all levels
- Unauthorized access attempts are logged and may result in account suspension

6. ACCEPTABLE USE
You agree not to:
- Use the Service for any unlawful purpose or in violation of labor laws
- Attempt to gain unauthorized access to other accounts, systems, or data
- Reverse-engineer, decompile, or disassemble any part of the Service
- Transmit malicious code, viruses, or harmful content
- Interfere with the Service's operation or stability
- Use the Service to discriminate against employees based on protected characteristics (race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, etc.)
- Exceed reasonable usage limits or abuse API endpoints (>10,000 requests/hour)
- Scrape or extract data without authorization
- Conduct security testing without written permission
- Harass, threaten, or abuse other users
- Use the Service for commercial purposes outside of scheduling your own organization

7. AI-GENERATED SCHEDULES

A. NATURE OF AI SCHEDULING
Schedules generated by WizScheduler's AI are optimized suggestions based on your inputs. They are not guarantees.

B. MANAGER RESPONSIBILITY
You are responsible for:
- Reviewing all generated schedules before publishing
- Verifying that schedules comply with all applicable labor laws
- Making final decisions about shift assignments
- Identifying and fixing any errors the AI may have made
- Ensuring compliance with minimum wage, overtime, rest period, and scheduling notice requirements

C. COMPLIANCE LIMITATIONS
WizScheduler includes Fair Workweek compliance checking for NYC (11-hour rest, 14-day notice, clopening restrictions). However:
- Compliance features are provided as-is and are not guaranteed
- You are responsible for verifying compliance with all labor laws
- Other jurisdictions may have different requirements not covered by our checker
- We recommend consulting with a labor attorney if you operate in highly regulated jurisdictions

D. LIABILITY
We are not liable for:
- Violations of labor laws resulting from generated schedules
- Financial penalties, fines, or lawsuits arising from non-compliance
- Employee disputes or claims related to scheduling decisions
- Errors in AI-generated schedules that you publish without review

8. DATA OWNERSHIP AND LICENSE
A. YOUR DATA
You retain full ownership of all employee and scheduling data you input into the Service.

B. OUR LICENSE
By using the Service, you grant us:
- A limited license to process your data solely to provide the Service
- The right to transmit data to third-party processors (Anthropic, email providers, etc.) as described in our Privacy Policy
- The right to use aggregate, anonymized data to improve the Service

C. RESTRICTIONS
You may not:
- Transfer data licenses to other parties
- Use the Service to process data on behalf of third parties
- Claim ownership of WizScheduler improvements derived from your data

9. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY

A. OUR IP
The Service, including its software, algorithms, design, documentation, and business logic, is owned by Suggestival LLC and protected by intellectual property laws.

B. YOUR RIGHTS
These Terms grant you a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable right to use the Service. You may not:
- License the Service to others
- Modify or create derivative works
- Sell access to the Service
- Claim ownership of the Service or any component

C. FEEDBACK
Feedback you provide about the Service can be used by us without restriction or compensation.

10. THIRD-PARTY INTEGRATIONS
The Service may integrate with third-party services (7shifts, Deputy, Homebase, etc.):
- We are not responsible for third-party availability, accuracy, or practices
- Third-party data transfers are governed by those services' terms and privacy policies
- We act as an intermediary; you are responsible for compliance with third-party terms
- Integration failures are not our liability, but we will assist in troubleshooting

11. SERVICE AVAILABILITY AND MAINTENANCE

A. UPTIME
We strive to maintain 99.5% uptime but do not guarantee uninterrupted access.

B. MAINTENANCE
We may perform maintenance, updates, or modifications that temporarily affect availability. We will:
- Provide 48 hours' notice of planned downtime where possible
- Perform maintenance during low-traffic hours (typically 2-6 AM UTC)
- Minimize downtime duration

C. EMERGENCY MAINTENANCE
We may perform emergency maintenance without notice to address security vulnerabilities or critical outages.

12. CHARGES AND BILLING

A. FREE TIER
- Up to 2 locations, 25 employees, 1 schedule generation per location per month
- Free tier users may be invited to upgrade

B. PAID PLANS
- Pro plan: $18/month per location (billed monthly)
- Payment via credit card or invoice (enterprise)
- All charges in USD unless otherwise agreed

C. BILLING
- Charges are billed on the date you upgrade
- You can cancel at any time via account settings; no refunds for partial months
- Past-due accounts may be suspended after 30 days
- We may increase prices with 30 days' notice

D. DISPUTED CHARGES
Notify us within 30 days of a disputed charge. After 30 days, we cannot contest the charge with your payment processor.

13. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
TO THE MAXIMUM EXTENT PERMITTED BY LAW, WIZSCHEDULER AND SUGGESTIVAL LLC SHALL NOT BE LIABLE FOR:
- INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, CONSEQUENTIAL, OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES
- LOSS OF PROFITS, DATA, REVENUE, GOODWILL, OR BUSINESS OPPORTUNITIES
- DAMAGES ARISING FROM YOUR USE OR INABILITY TO USE THE SERVICE
- DAMAGES ARISING FROM THIRD-PARTY SERVICES OR INTEGRATIONS
- LABOR LAW VIOLATIONS OR COMPLIANCE FAILURES
- EMPLOYEE DISPUTES OR CLAIMS RELATED TO SCHEDULING

OUR TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THESE TERMS SHALL NOT EXCEED THE FEES YOU PAID IN THE 12 MONTHS PRECEDING THE CLAIM.

14. INDEMNIFICATION
You agree to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Suggestival LLC from any claims, damages, or expenses (including attorney fees) arising from:
- Your use of the Service
- Your violation of these Terms
- Your violation of any applicable law or regulation
- Your violation of third-party rights
- Labor law violations resulting from your scheduling decisions
- Employee disputes or claims related to schedules you publish

15. TERMINATION

A. BY YOU
You may delete your account at any time via the account deletion endpoint (DELETE /api/v1/gdpr/delete-account). Upon deletion, all your data will be permanently deleted within 30 days.

B. BY US
We may suspend or terminate your access if you:
- Violate these Terms
- Violate applicable law
- Engage in harmful or abusive behavior
- Exceed usage limits repeatedly
- Fail to pay charges for 30 days

C. EFFECT OF TERMINATION
Upon termination:
- Your account access is revoked
- Your data is deleted in accordance with our Privacy Policy
- Provisions regarding liability, indemnification, and IP rights survive termination

16. DISPUTE RESOLUTION

A. INFORMAL RESOLUTION
Before pursuing legal action, you agree to notify us in writing and attempt to resolve the dispute. We will respond within 30 days.

B. GOVERNING LAW
These Terms are governed by the laws of the jurisdiction in which Suggestival LLC is registered, without regard to conflict of law principles.

C. JURISDICTION
You agree to submit to the jurisdiction of the courts in that jurisdiction for any disputes.

D. ARBITRATION (If Applicable)
Some jurisdictions may require arbitration. Both parties agree to arbitration before litigation for disputes exceeding $5,000.

17. CHANGES TO TERMS
We reserve the right to modify these Terms at any time. Material changes will be communicated via email or in-app notification at least 30 days in advance. Continued use of the Service after changes constitutes acceptance. If you do not accept changes, you may delete your account.

18. SEVERABILITY
If any provision of these Terms is found unenforceable, the remaining provisions remain in effect.

19. ENTIRE AGREEMENT
These Terms, along with our Privacy Policy and DPA, constitute the entire agreement between you and Suggestival LLC regarding the Service and supersede all prior or contemporaneous agreements.

20. CONTACT
For questions about these Terms, contact us at:
- Email: admin@suggestival.com
- Response Time: We respond within 5 business days

dpa.content:
DATA PROCESSING AGREEMENT FOR WIZSCHEDULER

Effective Date: April 5, 2026
Last Updated: October 12, 2026

1. SCOPE AND PURPOSE
This Data Processing Agreement ("DPA") forms part of the Terms of Service between Suggestival LLC, operating as WizScheduler ("Processor") and the customer organization ("Controller"). It governs the processing of personal data by the Processor on behalf of the Controller in connection with the WizScheduler scheduling service, in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), CCPA, and other applicable data protection laws.

2. DEFINITIONS
Terms used in this DPA have the meanings given in the GDPR (Regulation (EU) 2016/679) unless otherwise defined herein:
- "Personal Data": Any data relating to an identified or identifiable natural person processed through the Service.
- "Processing": Any operation performed on data (storage, retrieval, transmission, optimization, etc.).
- "Data Subject": An employee or person whose data is processed (not the organization).
- "Controller": The organization that owns the WizScheduler account and determines how data is used.
- "Processor": Suggestival LLC, which processes data on the Controller's behalf.

3. PROCESSING DETAILS

A. SCOPE
- Subject Matter: Provision of AI-powered employee scheduling services.
- Duration: For the term of the service agreement, plus as required for legal compliance.
- Nature and Purpose: Storage, retrieval, transmission to AI models, and optimization of employee scheduling data.

B. TYPES OF PERSONAL DATA
- Employee names, email addresses, phone numbers
- Work availability windows, shift preferences, constraints
- Role assignments, skill levels, seniority ratings
- Interpersonal affinity scores and team preferences
- Shift history, schedule assignments
- Pay rate information, overtime signals
- Check-in activity (location, date, time)
- Technical data (IP addresses, device identifiers)

C. CATEGORIES OF DATA SUBJECTS
- Employees of the Controller's organization
- Managers and administrators

D. DURATION
- During active subscription: Data is retained and processed.
- After termination: Data is deleted within 30 days unless retention is legally required.

4. OBLIGATIONS OF THE PROCESSOR

A. PROCESSING INSTRUCTIONS
The Processor shall:
- Process Personal Data only on documented instructions from the Controller
- Process data solely for the purposes specified in these Terms and Privacy Policy
- Not process data for any other purpose without explicit Controller instruction
- Comply with the Controller's data handling preferences and restrictions

B. CONFIDENTIALITY
The Processor shall:
- Ensure that persons authorized to process Personal Data have committed to confidentiality
- Restrict access to Personal Data to employees who need it to perform their duties
- Provide annual confidentiality training to relevant staff
- Require third-party employees (contractors, consultants) to sign confidentiality agreements

C. TECHNICAL AND ORGANIZATIONAL SECURITY
The Processor shall implement and maintain:
- Encryption of data at rest (AES-256 or equivalent) and in transit (TLS 1.2+)
- Secure password hashing using bcrypt
- JWT-based authentication with configurable token expiration
- Multi-tenant data isolation at the application and database level
- Security headers (HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, CSP)
- Firewalls and intrusion detection systems
- Regular security updates and patches
- Vulnerability scanning and penetration testing (annually)
- Access logs and audit trails

D. ASSISTANCE WITH RIGHTS REQUESTS
The Processor shall:
- Assist the Controller in responding to data subject rights requests within 30 days
- Provide extracted data in a machine-readable format (JSON, CSV) upon request
- Delete or return Personal Data upon instruction
- Certify deletion in writing
- Not charge additional fees for reasonable assistance requests

E. DELETION OR RETURN
The Processor shall, at the Controller's choice:
- Permanently delete all Personal Data upon termination of the service
- Return all Personal Data to the Controller in a structured format
- Certify deletion or return in writing
- Delete data from all backups within 30 days (encrypted backups may be retained longer for recovery purposes)

F. COMPLIANCE DOCUMENTATION
The Processor shall:
- Make available all information necessary to demonstrate compliance with this DPA
- Maintain records of processing activities (Purpose, Retention, Recipients)
- Provide compliance certifications upon request
- Document security measures and incident response procedures

G. BREACH NOTIFICATION
The Processor shall notify the Controller without undue delay, and in any case within 72 hours of becoming aware of a confirmed or suspected Personal Data breach, providing:
- The nature of the breach and categories of data affected
- Approximate number of data subjects affected
- Likely consequences of the breach
- Measures taken or proposed to mitigate the breach
- Contact point for further information

5. SUB-PROCESSORS

A. AUTHORIZED SUB-PROCESSORS
The Controller authorizes the use of the following sub-processors listed in the processors table of this document:
- Anthropic (AI schedule generation)
- 7shifts, Deputy, Homebase (data export/import)
- Resend (email delivery)
- Cloud infrastructure provider (data hosting)

B. SUB-PROCESSOR CHANGES
The Processor shall:
- Notify the Controller at least 30 days in advance of any intended changes to sub-processors
- Provide information about the new sub-processor's security practices
- Give the Controller the opportunity to object to the new sub-processor
- Allow the Controller to delete their account if they object to a sub-processor change
- Ensure that sub-processors are bound by data protection obligations equivalent to this DPA
- Remain liable to the Controller for sub-processor performance

6. DATA TRANSFERS

A. INTRA-EU TRANSFERS
Data transfers within the EU/EEA comply with GDPR without additional safeguards.

B. TRANSFERS OUTSIDE THE EU/EEA
Where Personal Data is transferred outside the EU/EEA (e.g., to the US for Anthropic API calls or cloud hosting), the Processor ensures appropriate safeguards are in place:
- EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) are executed with each sub-processor
- Transfer Impact Assessments (TIAs) are conducted per GDPR Article 46
- Supplementary measures are implemented as necessary to ensure adequate protection
- The Controller is notified of any legal challenges to adequacy decisions

C. RECIPIENT COUNTRIES
Personal Data may be transferred to:
- United States (Anthropic, Resend, cloud infrastructure)
- Canada (7shifts)
- Other jurisdictions as required for service delivery

7. SECURITY MEASURES

A. TECHNICAL MEASURES
- Encryption of data at rest in the primary database (AES-256)
- Encryption of data in transit via TLS 1.2+ (minimum cipher strength: 128-bit)
- Secure password hashing using bcrypt (cost factor ≥ 10)
- JWT authentication with signed tokens (HS256 or RS256)
- Configurable token expiration (default 1 hour)
- Secure session management

B. ORGANIZATIONAL MEASURES
- Multi-tenant data isolation enforced at the application and database level
- Role-based access control (RBAC) restricting access by job function
- Principle of least privilege: employees access only data they need
- Regular security awareness training for all staff
- Background checks for employees with data access
- Confidentiality agreements signed by all employees
- Non-disclosure agreements with contractors

C. MONITORING AND LOGGING
- API request logging (not including request bodies)
- Access logs for database connections
- Audit trails for configuration changes
- Intrusion detection system (IDS) monitoring
- Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) for alert correlation
- Log retention: 30 days for access logs, 1 year for audit logs

D. INCIDENT RESPONSE
- Documented incident response procedures
- 24/7 on-call incident response team
- Rapid containment and remediation procedures
- Regular incident response drills

8. DATA BREACH NOTIFICATION

A. TIMING
The Processor shall notify the Controller without undue delay, and in any case within 72 hours of becoming aware of a confirmed or suspected Personal Data breach.

B. NOTIFICATION CONTENT
Notification shall include:
- The nature of the breach (unauthorized access, accidental deletion, encryption key compromise, etc.)
- Categories of data affected (employee names, availability data, etc.)
- Approximate number of data subjects affected
- Probable consequences of the breach
- Measures taken or proposed to mitigate the breach and prevent recurrence
- Contact point for the data protection officer or other responsible person

C. INVESTIGATION
The Processor shall conduct a prompt investigation to determine the scope and impact of the breach.

D. CONTROLLER RESPONSIBILITY
The Controller remains responsible for notifying data subjects and regulatory authorities where required under GDPR Article 33-34.

9. AUDITS AND INSPECTIONS

A. RIGHT TO AUDIT
The Controller or an authorized independent auditor may conduct audits of the Processor's compliance with this DPA.

B. NOTICE
The Controller shall provide reasonable notice (at least 15 days) before conducting an audit, except in the case of security incidents.

C. COOPERATION
The Processor shall:
- Provide access to relevant facilities, equipment, and records
- Respond to auditor questions and requests
- Provide certifications of compliance (SOC 2, ISO 27001, etc.)
- Not charge additional fees for reasonable audit requests (more than one audit per year may incur reasonable costs)

D. REMEDIATION
The Controller or auditor may recommend corrective actions. The Processor shall address findings within 30 days of the audit report.

10. STANDARD CONTRACTUAL CLAUSES (SCCs)
For transfers of Personal Data outside the EU/EEA, this DPA incorporates the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (Module One: Controller-Processor). The Processor ensures that sub-processors also execute SCCs or equivalent safeguards.

11. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
Nothing in this DPA limits the liability of either party for:
- Personal Data breaches or violations of data protection laws
- Breach of confidentiality obligations
- Fraud or gross negligence

Liability for all other claims remains subject to the limitation of liability in the Terms of Service.

12. TERMINATION

A. UPON EXPIRATION OR TERMINATION OF AGREEMENT
Within 30 days of termination, the Processor shall, at the Controller's written choice:
- Permanently delete all Personal Data
- Return all Personal Data in a structured, machine-readable format
- Certify deletion or return in writing

B. DATA RETENTION FOR LEGAL COMPLIANCE
The Processor may retain limited Personal Data for as long as required by applicable law (e.g., for tax compliance, audit trails, legal holds).

C. BACKUP RETENTION
Encrypted database backups may be retained for an additional 30 days for disaster recovery purposes, after which they must be securely destroyed.

13. GOVERNING LAW AND JURISDICTION
This DPA shall be governed by the laws of the jurisdiction in which Suggestival LLC is registered, supplemented by GDPR requirements where applicable. Any dispute arising from this DPA shall be subject to the dispute resolution procedures in the Terms of Service.

14. CONTACT
For inquiries regarding this DPA or data protection compliance:
- Email: admin@suggestival.com
- Response Time: We respond within 5 business days
- Data Protection Officer: Available upon request
